correctness.rationale: Exact ratio cancellation gives monotonic quotients and lower logistic bound for first occupied species. Left-to-right induction gives persistent vs exponential extinct coordinates. Every adjacent pair has an exponentially extinct/zero member, hence predation budget decays. Positive total density solves a forced logistic equation with exponential convergence. Ratios then converge exponentially; quotient integration gives the exact extinction exponent and finite positive prefactor. All boundary cases and quantifiers covered; SymPy identities checked.
